evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, professional: 2. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Japanese availability and strong IAM/VPC coverage support professional security configuration at three years; a vendor-specific multiple-choice exam and smaller recorded platform footprint limit broader architecture claims.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Strong recorded IAM and VPC coverage plus a three-year profile support professional GCP security responsibility. The multiple-choice format requires separate validation of operational execution, and the vendor scope limits portability.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded IAM and VPC coverage is directly relevant to cloud engagements. I discount the Professional title because the assessment is explicitly multiple choice and multiple response, without documented practical implementation.
